trigger_condition: Project changes after assistants were picked for the msteams assistant_ids field
potential_consequence: Stale assistant ids from the old project are submitted with the new project, referencing assistants invalid for it

trigger_condition: assistantMultiSelect rendered before a project is chosen (project='')
guard_snippet: disabled={!project || resourceLoading} on the assistantMultiSelect MultiSelect
potential_consequence: getAssistantOptions is called without a project filter, letting the user pick assistants outside any project scope

trigger_condition: Editing an existing msteams setting whose stored assistant_ids include an id outside the first 100 fetched (or excluded by current search filter)
guard_snippet: fetch/merge selected ids by id (e.g. options+ids param) so every selected value resolves to a label
potential_consequence: Previously selected assistants render as raw ids or drop out of the visible chip text instead of their names

trigger_condition: Hook renders on integrations list before appInfoStore.fetchCustomerConfig has resolved anywhere else in the session
potential_consequence: MS Teams Bot option silently missing from the integration type filter until config loads elsewhere

trigger_condition: Same credentialFields config rendered twice by SettingsForm (position=top and position=fieldsSection)
guard_snippet: only call useResourceOptions when the assistantMultiSelect field is actually rendered at this position
potential_consequence: Two parallel getAssistantOptions requests fire per keystroke/project change even though only one instance renders the field

trigger_condition: tabs.tsx no longer imports isTeamsEnabled after removing the Teams Bot admin tab
guard_snippet: Remove isTeamsEnabled/useTeamsEnabled and their stale mocks in tabs.customerConfiguration.test.tsx / tabs.auditor.test.tsx, or reuse them
potential_consequence: Dead exports and stale test mocks remain, masking that the flag no longer gates any UI
